employerEnquiry.description: We review all enquiries within 1 business day. By law, all sponsorship costs must be borne by the employer — they cannot be charged to or recovered from visa holders.
employerEnquiry.labelIsApprovedSponsor: Is your business currently an approved Standard Business Sponsor?
employerEnquiry.labelHasPreviouslySponsored: Have you previously sponsored overseas workers?
employerEnquiry.labelCanProvideBusinessEvidence: Can you provide evidence of lawful business operation (ASIC records, financial statements)?
employerEnquiry.labelCanDemonstrateFinancialCapacity: Can the business demonstrate financial capacity to pay the required market salary rate?
employerEnquiry.labelLocalOverseasRatio: Current ratio of local Australian to overseas employees (approximate)
employerEnquiry.labelIsOnCSOL: Is the proposed occupation on the Core Skills Occupation List (CSOL)?
employerEnquiry.labelWillingToDoLMT: Are you willing to undertake Labour Market Testing (4-week advertising on 2 platforms)?
employerEnquiry.labelCanProvidePositionDescription: Can you provide a detailed position description meeting ANZSCO skill level requirements?
employerEnquiry.labelWillCoverAllFees: Will the business cover all sponsorship, nomination, and legal fees? (These costs must not be charged to visa holders.)
employerEnquiry.labelAwareOfSAFLevy: Are you aware of the SAF (Skilling Australians Fund) levy requirements?
employerEnquiry.labelWillCoverRelocation: If required, will you cover relocation costs?
employerEnquiry.labelWillProvideFullTimeContract: Will you provide a full-time, legally binding ongoing employment contract?
employerEnquiry.labelPreparedForCompliance: Are you prepared to meet compliance requirements (timesheets, payslips)?
employerEnquiry.labelOffersPRPathway: Does the position offer a PR pathway (e.g. 186 TRT)?
employerEnquiry.disclaimer: We review all enquiries within 1 business day. By law, all sponsorship costs must be borne by the employer — they cannot be charged to or recovered from visa holders.
employerEnquiry.successMessage: We will be in touch within 1 business day.
employerEnquiry.validationEmail: Please enter a valid email address
